_comment: Verified legal-name aliases for currently-discovered employers whose real government/public LCA filing records use a legal entity name that app.registry.normalize's suffix-stripping does not reduce to the registry's brand-name normalized_name (e.g. 'Ramp Business Corporation' vs registry brand 'Ramp'). Every entry here was confirmed against real USCIS H-1B Employer Data Hub (FY2021-2024) and/or h1bdata.info LCA records during the sponsorship-intelligence-coverage-v1 build -- this is NOT a guess/fuzzy-match list. Loaded by app.sponsorship.aliases.seed_known_aliases(). Extend only with a similarly verified real legal-name mapping; never add an entry to force a company toward a particular sponsorship outcome.
